model_name: Regulated Operations Digital Twin Object Model
purpose: Define a shared software-defined regulated operations digital twin object model for Compound Pharmacy, IRLT / Radiopharma Operations, DSCSA, MES, equipment, quality, workflow dependency, AI governance, evidence integrity, and RAMAT Vision display without deploying Azure Digital Twins or connecting to real production systems.
core_doctrine: The digital twin is a regulated operations state model, not a source system.
The twin represents evidence, dependency, identity, quality, AI, equipment, supply-chain, and workflow state for assurance evaluation.
The twin does not replace MES, LIS, ERP, eQMS, VRS, EPCIS, ServiceNow, QMS, LIMS, SCADA, PLC, historian, BMS, or pharmacy systems.
Official records remain in source systems.

object_families.purpose: Represent user, device, role, persona, entitlement, and session context.
Represent equipment identity, CI identity, lifecycle, support group, ownership, validation, calibration, PM, and operational-readiness state.
Represent hidden dependencies across workflow steps, source systems, required evidence, review gates, and blocking states.
Represent evidence objects, source references, hash state, rehash triggers, provenance, custody, and audit-readiness state.

object_families.object_family_name: Quality, Deviation, CAPA, and Review State
object_families.purpose: Represent quality dependency, deviation impact, CAPA linkage, review state, SOP alignment, validation, and Quality Unit accountability.

object_families.object_family_name: Material, Product, Serialization, and Supply-Chain State
object_families.purpose: Represent material genealogy, lot state, supplier evidence, serialized product identity, DSCSA event state, EPCIS evidence, VRS response, and trading-partner trust.

object_families.object_family_name: Manufacturing, Compounding, and Radiopharma Execution Context
object_families.purpose: Represent batch, preparation, formula, BUD, execution context, timing sensitivity, handoff state, and operational readiness.

object_families.object_family_name: AI Agent, Recommendation, and Content State
object_families.purpose: Represent AI-generated summaries, recommendations, classifications, prompts, model versions, tool calls, human review, output hash, and recommendation-versus-approval boundary.

object_families.object_family_name: RAMAT Vision / Thread D2 Display State
object_families.purpose: Represent field display, role-based view, read-only review state, evidence prompts, readiness display, and Platform B1 decision display without approving regulated work.

relationship_types.description: Equipment is represented by or linked to a configuration item.
A workflow step depends on required evidence before it can be considered complete.
An evidence object has a hash record and may require rehashing when source evidence changes.
An AI output requires human review before it can support a regulated action.
A DSCSA event is linked to EPCIS evidence.
A serialized product verification state is linked to a VRS response.
A compound preparation is linked to a formula record.
An IRLT / radiopharma execution context is linked to controlled handoff evidence.
A Platform B1 decision may be displayed by RAMAT Vision / Thread D2 without becoming approval authority.
